name: How does bathroom countertop installation actually work?
description: It usually goes: measure, template, fabricate, then install. Expect sink cutouts, faucet holes, and final cleanup at the end.

mainEntity.name: How does bathroom countertop installation actually work?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process usually includes an in-home measurement, material selection, digital templating, fabrication, and final installation. Local Denver-area providers often bring samples to your home, then return to install the finished countertop, drill faucet holes, support the sink, and clean up afterward.
